_comment: Pricing matrix for Printify POD products. Base costs are averages across top providers. Margins target 60-70% gross profit. All prices in USD.

rules: Never price below 2.5x base cost — leaves room for Etsy fees (6.5%) + Etsy ads (15%) + profit
Round retail prices to .99 — psychological pricing converts better
Premium aesthetics (design-intelligence scored 80+) can command 10-20% premium
Bundle pricing: sticker packs at 3x single price for 5-pack, 5x for 12-pack
Seasonal items (Christmas, Valentine's) can be priced 15-25% higher Oct-Dec and Jan-Feb
First 30 days: price at floor to build reviews, then raise to target after 5+ reviews

fee_structure.etsy_offsite_ads_note: Only charged when a sale comes from Etsy's offsite ads. Shops under $10k/yr can opt out.
fee_structure.printify_subscription_note: Free plan. Premium ($29.99/mo) gives 20% off all products.

example.note: At $24.99 the margin is ~52%. To hit 65%, price would need to be $29.99 ($20.73 - 9.27 = 65%). But $24.99 is more competitive for new shops.

t-shirt_premium.notes: Most popular POD blank. Soft, retail-quality fit. Price at $24.99-26.99 for new shops.

t-shirt_budget.notes: Budget-friendly option. Heavier fabric. Good for novelty/humor designs.

hoodie.notes: Higher base cost but strong margins at target. Best sellers in fall/winter.

mug_11oz.notes: High perceived value, low base cost. Great margin product. Fragile shipping adds cost.

mug_15oz.notes: Upsell from 11oz. Offer both sizes as variants.

stickers_single.notes: Low price point drives impulse buys. Volume seller. Offer multiple sizes.

stickers_sheet.notes: Higher AOV than singles. 6-12 stickers per sheet. Great for themed collections.

phone_case.notes: Many model variants. Must list compatible devices in tags/description.

tote_bag.notes: Eco-friendly angle in description. 'Reusable', 'sustainable' are strong keywords.

poster.notes: Varies greatly by size. 8x10 cheapest, 24x36 highest base cost. Price per size.

desk_mat.notes: Niche product with dedicated buyers. Gaming/WFH audience. Lower competition.

notebook.notes: Journal/planner audience. 'Lined notebook', 'writing journal' are strong tags.
